paper_id: Li et al. - 2007 - EOS expertise oriented search using social networks
title: EOS: Expertise Oriented Search Using Social Networks
motivation: Researchers need to find domain experts efficiently, but existing methods lack social relationship context
problem_framing: Expert search as relevancy ranking problem enhanced by propagating scores through co-authorship network
key_insight: Topic relevance propagates via co-authorship edges: an expert's neighbors inherit some relevancy
method_signature: Two-stage propagation-based expert finding + heap-Dijkstra association search on social graph
evaluation_criteria: Conference committee membership as ground truth; comparison to baseline IR methods
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Heuristic rules for name disambiguation (weakness admitted); no evaluation of disambiguation accuracy
evidence_for_tast: improve the performance of expert finding
The main difficulty is the time efficiency
heuristic rules to deal with name disambiguation
thinking_moves: 把专家搜索问题从纯文档匹配扩展到网络传播，利用co-authorship关系传递相关性信号
先计算本地相关性作为种子值，再通过网络迭代传播，比单纯local IR更强
关联搜索的核心约束是时间效率，倒逼采用heap-Dijkstra等高效算法而非穷举
extraction_notes: Venue not explicitly stated in paper; role based on author ordering (4th of 6)
